name: Witty Dodo 51
author: Praashoo7
description: Gradient 3d gray toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ccc to limegreen, transform becomes translateY(2.3em), transform becomes rotateZ(90deg) rotateY(180deg) translateY(0.45em) translateX(-1.4em). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px limegreen.
